scenicChapters.title: Oslo / Norway Scenic Roads return → Hardanger Fjord and Waterfalls foo
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 61 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

oslo-norway-scenic-roads-hardanger-fjord.story: From Sørumsand it runs 772 km to Kløfta; allow about 16 h 27 of riding. It goes by way of near Hønefoss, near Sande, Nesoddtangen and near Askim. The climbs: near Tofte, near Skjønhaug and Scenic stretch near Fetsund.
